goal: Make prevention recurrence a provenance-backed, generation-aware epistemic signal that can challenge prevention effectiveness and generate durable validation work without fabricating counter-evidence.
current_work_unit: Repair cross-platform visual-evidence determinism blocking final external validation
next_units: verify durable epistemic/mission reports after merge

completion_gates.description: Prevention registry has generation semantics and attributed recurrence events.
Every prevention entry points to a current generation-specific effectiveness Claim.
A future active recurrence can atomically create contradiction Evidence against the current generation Claim.
Unattributed historical recurrence counts produce missions rather than synthetic contradiction Evidence.
Implementation passes CI, merges, and durable reports regenerate on main.

blockers: Validate Foundry #406/#407 failed because WindowsPath and PosixPath sort manifest filenames differently; recurrence epistemics tests themselves passed.
notes: This is a new project after the completed epistemic rebase; it does not reopen the previous PROJECT_COMPLETE state.
External validation blocker is unrelated to recurrence semantics: visual evidence generator used sorted(Path), whose WindowsPath order differs from PosixPath for FONTS vs FONT_REQUIREMENTS.
Repair uses p.as_posix() as the platform-stable sort key and adds a cross-platform regression test.
